visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a navy jacket with colorful floral and butterfly patterns, sits behind a white Shure microphone. He gestures with his hands while looking directly at the camera in a room with a bookshelf and cabinet. (2) A screen capture of the Tesla website displays the Model Y car and technical specifications in Chinese and English text. (3) The man returns to the frame, continuing his hand gestures and speech. (4) An animation shows a white car driving along a winding yellow road through green hills under a bright sun, with text overlays appearing. (5) The man is shown again, emphasizing points with his fingers. (6) A cartoon car is depicted charging, with yellow lightning bolt icons surrounding it and related text. (7) The man continues his presentation. (8) An animation shows a car parked in front of a house where a 'no charging' sign is visible; the car has a sad expression. (9) The man speaks while holding up his fingers to count points. (10) A cartoon interior of a car is shown with a boy listening to music; '16 SPEAKERS' and musical note icons are visible. (11) The man gives a final summary, followed by a black screen displaying a QR code and social media group information.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你會多花40萬元. [Logo]: @HanHan. (2) [Subtitle]: 買全新的Model Y LR版本嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 全新Model Y. [Slogan]: NT$2,299,900. (4) [Subtitle]: 全輪驅動版 $230萬. (5) [Subtitle]: RWD後輪驅動版 $190萬. (6) [Subtitle]: 大部分開過特斯拉的人都會認為便宜$40萬RWD的版本. (7) [Subtitle]: CP值高、折舊低, 適合90%以上的人. (8) [Subtitle]: 但我整理了4個點, 如果你很注重, 也許貴40萬的LR版本更適合你. (9) [Slogan]: 常開快車. (10) [Subtitle]: 第一, 常開快車, 而且會開山路. LR版本不只加速快, 過彎一定相對穩定. (11) [Slogan]: 快充的效率更高. (12) [Subtitle]: 第二, 快充的效率更高. LR是用三元鋰電池, 快充最高到250千瓦. (13) [Subtitle]: RWD版本的電池, 最快是到170千瓦. 250除以170, 這樣快幾成?. (14) [Slogan]: 適合家裡沒有充電樁的人. (15) [Subtitle]: 第三, 適合家裡沒有充電樁的人. 一般充到85%, 速度就會變得超級慢. (16) [Subtitle]: 在尖峰時間甚至不能充. LR 85% 實際大約可以跑410公里. (17) [Subtitle]: RWD是350公里. 多了60公里, 可以降低里程焦慮. (18) [Slogan]: 注重音質. (19) [Subtitle]: 第四, 注重音質. LR喇叭16顆, RWD只有9顆. (20) [Subtitle]: 基本上我是木耳, 聽不出來. 所以你會多花40萬買全新Model Y LR的版本嗎. (21) [Subtitle]: 底下留言. 掃QR Code 加入老爸社群 一起討論.
